expect_red: sweep: the four verification numbers are all there, the reference difference is a subtraction, and every label is derived from the artifact's own measure name

mutations.contract: Solved blade pitch, the sheet's reference, their difference, and each two-force member's measured |A - B| against its declared length. Those are the verification. The difference is solved minus reference, in that order and that sign.
mutations.note: The mutation flips the subtraction. Both arms are plausible on screen -- a signed residual of a few thousandths of a degree reads the same either way -- and the sign is the whole content when a reader is asking whether the solver runs high or low against the sheet.
mutations.find:
rows.push({ key: name + ":difference", label: label + " " + W.difference,
          value: point.measures[name] - referenceValue, unit: units[name] || null });
mutations.replace:
rows.push({ key: name + ":difference", label: label + " " + W.difference,
          value: referenceValue - point.measures[name], unit: units[name] || null });
